test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is true with regard to the establishment of Central Public Sector Undertakings in India?

options.text: They are established to fulfil the objective of a self-reliant India
They are supposed to reduce the importance of the private sector in India
They are only expected to generate greater profits to fund the Indian budget.
They are established solely for export-oriented industrialisation.

solution:
The correct answer is __**They are established to fulfil the objective of a self-reliant India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Central Public Sector Undertakings (CPSUs) are established with the primary objective of achieving a self-reliant India, focusing on critical sectors like energy, infrastructure, and manufacturing.
 
• They play a pivotal role in driving the nation's economic development by investing in large-scale industrial projects and ensuring the availability of essential goods and services.
 
• CPSUs help in reducing dependency on imports, promoting indigenous production, and fostering technological advancements within the country.
 
• They contribute significantly to employment generation, skill development, and regional development, thereby supporting overall socio-economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Role of CPSUs in Strategic Sectors**

 
 
• CPSUs are often established in strategic sectors such as defense, energy, and heavy industries to ensure national security and self-sufficiency.
 
• They contribute to the development of critical infrastructure, including power plants, highways, and ports, which are essential for economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Economic Contributions**
 
 
• CPSUs significantly contribute to the national exchequer through dividends, taxes, and other forms of revenue, aiding in the financial stability of the government.
 
• They also play a crucial role in stabilizing the economy during financial crises by maintaining steady production and employment levels.
 
 
 
• **Employment and Skill Development**
 
 
• CPSUs are major employers in the country, providing direct and indirect employment to millions of individuals.
 
• They invest in training and skill development programs, enhancing the employability and productivity of the workforce.
 
 
 
• **Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)**
 
 
• Many CPSUs actively engage in CSR activities, contributing to community development, education, healthcare, and environmental sustainability.
 
• These initiatives help in improving the quality of life for the underprivileged sections of society and promote inclusive growth.
